title: Mid-Level .NET Developer - Enterprise Applications
description_text: Enterprise Software Solutions is seeking a mid-level .NET developer with professional enterprise application development experience. In this role, you will work with C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET to maintain and extend business-critical applications used across our organization. You should have hands-on experience building features in enterprise-grade systems, working with complex business logic, testing your code, and collaborating in a professional development environment. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in enterprise-scale application development.
raw_text: Mid-Level .NET Developer - Enterprise Applications. Required: Professional experience with enterprise business applications, C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, SQL, unit testing, Git, Agile. Preferred: API design, Entity Framework, message queues, Docker.
requirements: Professional experience contributing to enterprise-grade business applications
Strong C# and .NET Core / ASP.NET skills
Experience with SQL databases and relational data modeling
Unit testing expertise (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, or equivalent)
Proficiency with Git-based workflows and code review practices
Ability to work with complex business logic and requirements
preferred_qualifications: Experience with API design and REST/GraphQL patterns
Familiarity with Entity Framework for ORM
Message queue or async processing experience
Experience with insurance, financial services, or administrative business domains
responsibilities: Develop features for enterprise business applications
Collaborate with team members through code review
Participate in Agile planning and retrospectives
Document technical decisions and implementation details
notes: REGRESSION TEST: This posting specifically asks for 'professional experience contributing to enterprise-grade business applications'. The fit analysis should NOT claim the candidate lacks enterprise application experience, as this is documented in profile/resume_facts.md. Acceptable outcomes: (1) Score the job high/apply because of enterprise BizLink/UWO/Applied experience, or (2) If there are gaps, frame them as specific seniority/ownership gaps, not lack of enterprise exposure. UNACCEPTABLE: Any claim that the candidate lacks enterprise application experience.
